services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: AquaTech’s year-round swim lessons make it easy for families to begin when they are ready-no need to wait for a new session. Swimmers can keep a reserved weekly lesson time and continue building water safety, confidence, and stronger swim skills through consistent instruction and steady progress. We also make enrollment and participation more flexible with Makeup Tokens for eligible reported absences, predictable four-week billing, advance billing reminders, and available family discounts and promotions. services.desc: Once a token is active on your account, it can be viewed and booked up to 7 days in advance. Makeup tokens will appear in the Customer Portal the day after the reported absence.
